reader_summary.overview: On today’s episode, Clay and Kyle review The Most Important Thing by Howard Marks and share their most impactful takeaways. Howard Marks is the co-founder and co-Chairman of Oaktree Capital Management, a global investment giant with more than $190 billion in assets. He’s also the author of two best-selling books.

key_points.text: He’s also the author of two best-selling books.
Warren Buffett has said, “When I see memos from Howard Marks in my mail, they’re the first thing I open and read.
I always learn something.” IN THIS EPISODE YOU’LL LEARN: 00:00 - Intro 05:12 - How second-level thinking can improve our skills as investors.
